quote: Mr. President. We don't have much time. Petrov gets here in 90 minutes. We need to talk Europe.
chinese: 总统先生 我们没多少时间 佩特罗夫90分钟后到 我们得谈欧洲的情况
reason: 用明确截止时间压缩决策准备窗口

quote: The answer is yes. To some, not all, of what you asked. I'm prepared to scale back significantly. I have to speak to my team first and my allies in NATO, but I'm confident that we can do something meaningful in Poland and the Czech Republic. Our people can work out the specifics. And whatever it is we decide and agree on, the public cannot know.
chinese: 答案是可以 可以接受你的部分但并非全部要求 我准备对导弹防御系统进行大规模削减 我得先跟团队及北约盟国商量 但我相信我们可以在波兰和捷克作出重要调整 双方可以协商细节 但无论达成怎样的共识 都不能让公众知晓
reason: 提出部分让步并设置盟友磋商与保密边界

quote: I can only consider a partial scale-back if you announce it. This press conference is about the Jordan Valley. The most important thing about the missiles is the scale-back, not the PR. My people would know I walked away with something. And, by announcing it, I can keep you to your word.
chinese: 只有你同意对外宣布 我才会接受部分削减 这场新闻发布会是关于约旦河谷问题 调整导弹防御系统的重点是削减 不是公关 我的人民需要知道我不是空手而归 而且对外宣布后 我就能逼你信守诺言
reason: 把公开宣布同时用作国内交代与履约约束

quote: I am more than meeting you halfway, Viktor.
chinese: 我可是做出了相当大的让步 维克多
reason: 用常见谈判表达强调让步幅度已超出对半妥协

quote: Have you ever been in a Lada? It's the worst car ever built. It was a coffin on wheels. But then, after the Fall, we got the Lexus. Temperature control. Automatic windows. And so much room. I want the Lexus. And you're trying to sell me a Lada.
chinese: 你坐过拉达牌汽车吗 那是世上最烂的车 简直是可移动的棺材 但苏联解体后 就能买到雷克萨斯 有空调 自动车窗 而且空间很大 我想要雷克萨斯 你却向我推销拉达
reason: 以拉达和雷克萨斯的长比喻拒绝缩水方案

quote: I'll have them bring your motorcade around. But the press conference. Right! I'd completely forgotten. But I think we're gonna be okay without one today. Have a safe journey home, Mr. President.
chinese: 我去让你的车队来接你 但还有新闻发布会 对啊 我忘得一干二净 不过今天不做新闻发布会也不要紧 回程一路顺风 总统先生
reason: 以礼貌送客和取消联合发布会宣告谈判破裂

quote: Last night, I had the pleasure of hosting some very special guests here at the White House. True Russian patriots who exhibit the very best that their country has to offer. They stood up to President Petrov, and forced him to listen to the truths that he didn't want to hear. That had a profound effect on me, because it made me realize that I need to stand up to him as well. As does our country.
chinese: 昨晚我有幸在白宫招待几位非常尊贵的宾客 几位真正的俄罗斯爱国者 他们展现了国家最优良的美德 他们敢于挑战佩特罗夫总统 并强迫他倾听不愿听到的真相 这令我深受震撼 因为这让我意识到我也要勇于与他抗衡 我们的国家也一样
reason: 由异见者的行动推导出国家必须公开抗衡

quote: When I invited the President here, I set out hoping to find a partner. But the demands that President Petrov made proves to me that peace is not a priority for him. Peace should not have to be bought. Peace should be its own reward, and we will achieve it, with or without him.
chinese: 我邀请总统来访是旨在结交盟友 但佩特罗夫总统的要求让我明白 和平并非他的第一诉求 和平不该通过买卖取得 和平本就该是回报 不论他是否是我们的盟友 我们终会迎来和平
reason: 从伙伴期待转向拒绝以利益购买和平的公开立场

quote: You have thoughts on how to bypass Russia. The idea is to negate Russia's veto in the Security Council. I'll let the Ambassador tell you what we have in mind.
chinese: 你知道怎样能绕过俄国 就是要让俄国在联合国安理会的否决票无效 我会让大使向您介绍我们的想法
reason: 将公开决裂立即转化为绕过否决权的执行交接
